title: Chandigarh & Dadra Nagar Haveli Become First UTs to Launch CBDC Food Subsidy Transfers
summary: PMGKAY food subsidy delivery fully digitized via Digital Rupee (e₹) tokens in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

blocks.content: PMGKAY food subsidy delivery fully digitized via Digital Rupee (e₹) tokens in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

items: **First UTs:** Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli launched CBDC-based Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for food subsidies under PMGKAY.
**Digital Token System:** Beneficiaries receive Digital Rupee (e₹) tokens for food grain purchases.
